responsibility: Defines the PowerPC AUXV and thread-control-block constants used for runtime CPU capability inspection on Linux. It records the GLIBC- and kernel-defined AT_PLATFORM, AT_HWCAP, and AT_HWCAP2 numeric values and the TCB offsets for retrieving them in 32-bit and 64-bit, big- and little-endian modes, supporting backend or builtin code that queries runtime processor features from the TLS/TCB area.
